prs.location:
Hazelwood Student Village 

Local Bus Routes with access to all the key colleges in Dublin Trinity, DCU, DIT, ITB, RCSI, DBS, St. Patricks College, All Hallows College and other key schools and campuses.

Based in Northwood, there are a number of local shops, restaurants and food outlets all within walking distance.
There is a Ben Dunne Gym directly outside of the complex and a number of local sport facilities within the local area.

The accommodation is also located within a 10 Minute to Dublin Airport.

With a dedicated onsite team available Mon-Fri there will always be someone to help with enquires and the receiving of packages/mail.
